description:
Give a design its title — the name `designs` lists it by.

Without `uri`, renames the design you are working on: its next `export({ format: 'imgly' })` saves under the title, and if it is saved already, the saved design is renamed now. With `uri` (from `designs` or a save), renames that saved design.

Returns JSON `{ uri, title, previousTitle }`, or `{ title }` while the design is not saved yet. Nothing in the design changes.

uri.description: A saved design to rename. Omit it to rename the design you are working on.

name: rename
